name: split-button
title: Split button
description: A main action joined to a chevron that opens the related ones (Send | Schedule send, Send and archive, Save draft). Alt + ↓ opens the menu from either half and focus stays in it: arrows, Home / End and type-ahead move the highlight, Enter picks, Escape or Tab hand focus back to the chevron. The chevron turns, the menu grows from its corner and flips up when there is no room below.
